LanguageData.TSA_WD_DescIntelLos: Soft fog of war: discovery, MaxLOS rings, scouts, Strategic Expand, and Got Burned caution.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderFeatureGateTip: Never turns the feature fully off. Any other value starts discovery and scouts on day 0, and fogs raid logic once the stage is reached.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_GateSettlementIntelTip: Never = feature off (perfect information, no scouts, no View gizmo). Always / From Mid / From Late: discovery and scouts from day 0; raid assess fog starts when that stage is reached.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderTargetRingsTip: Fraction of an observer's MaxLOS at which each target class is spotted. Big targets use the outer edge; small targets only the inner rings. Shared by settlements, travelers, and scouts.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_RingFracT1Tip: Smallest sites, weak travelers, AT turrets, and advanced buildings. Spotted only inside this fraction of MaxLOS.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_RingFracT2Tip: Medium sites and travelers of class T2.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_RingFracT3Tip: Large sites and travelers of class T3.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_RingFracT4Tip: Largest sites and travelers of class T4. Usually equal to MaxLOS.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderSettlementLosTip: Base sight is the tier attack-range baseline. It grows with settlement age and game stage up to the MaxLOS multiplier, and ignores zeal and attack-range bonuses.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_SettlementLosMaxMultTip: At Late stage and maximum settlement age, MaxLOS reaches baseline times this value. Half of the growth comes from age, half from Mid/Late stage. Does not use zeal or attack-range bonuses.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderTravelerLosTip: Traveler MaxLOS and class come from departure strength (initialStrength). Attrition never changes class.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT1Tip: Maximum sight for the weakest traveler class.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT2Tip: Maximum sight for class T2 travelers.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT3Tip: Maximum sight for class T3 travelers.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT4Tip: Maximum sight for the strongest traveler class.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT2Tip: Travelers at or above this departure strength are class T2. Also the AT long-range fire threshold (outer accuracy band).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT3Tip: Travelers at or above this departure strength are class T3.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT4Tip: Travelers at or above this departure strength are class T4.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutMaxLosTip: Fixed MaxLOS for scout missions, independent of scout strength. With default rings, T1 targets are seen at half of this range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerCaravanMaxLosTip: How far a real player caravan can spot hostile sites for the player discovery set (FoW prep). The player always has perfect gameplay information.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderScoutsStrategicTip: Scouts launch whenever the gate is configured (early game). Strategic Expand only when raid-logic fog is active.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_WeightScoutTip: Daily-action weight for launching ring scouts. Same ballpark as Trader by default.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutClearWeightMultTip: When the settlement's attack ring has no known hostiles, scout weight is multiplied by this.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutStrengthMinTip: Minimum departure strength for a scout. Kept at or above the T2 class boundary so scouts stay long-range AT eligible.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutStrengthMaxTip: Maximum departure strength for a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutCooldownDaysTip: Per-settlement cooldown after launching a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutCrackFallTip: Chance that an NPC interceptor treats a scout as a crack-faller and lets it through. Player intercepts are unchanged.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutBearingAvoidTip: Scouts avoid launching toward bearings that already have a known hostile within this cone.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_WeightStrategicExpandTip: Peso de acción diaria de Strategic Expand. Prefiere fundar en sitios seguros: fuera de la vista de enemigos cercanos, fuera de corredores geodésicos hacia los hostiles más próximos, y no hacia el jugador. Usa conocimiento perfecto de hostiles cercanos (no depende de la niebla de guerra).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_StrategicExpandSamplesTip: Cuántas casillas candidatas muestra Strategic Expand antes de elegir el sitio más seguro.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderGotBurnedTip: After a raid undercounts defenders, the next assess vs that primary inflates known defender strength (caution only).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_BurnedHiddenPctTip: After a raid undercounts defenders, the next assess vs that primary inflates known defender strength by this percent (caution only; no free neighbor discovery).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_GotBurnedDaysTip: How long the GotBurned caution stamp lasts on a primary target before it expires.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_BurnTriggerRatioTip: If true defender strength exceeds the fogged assess by this ratio, stamp GotBurned on the attacker.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_ShowSightRadiusDesc: Draw golden MaxLOS fill with target-size discovery bands around this object. Small targets only inside the inner ring; medium farther out; big targets out to the outer edge.\n\nRange: {0}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_ShowSightRadiusDescPlayer: Draw golden MaxLOS fill with target-size discovery bands. The player always sees everything in gameplay; this only drives the intel view.\n\nRange: {0}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_SightRadiusBandsLegend:
Color bands (discoverable target size):
Red = 0–{0}% of MaxLOS. All sizes (small / medium / big).
Orange = {0}–{1}% of MaxLOS. Medium and big only.
Yellow = {1}–{2}% of MaxLOS. Big targets only (outer MaxLOS).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ViewAsGateOff: Puerta de intel en Nunca (función desactivada)
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ViewAsPlayerTip: La vista de jugador muestra el mapa mundial completo (todo visible). Juego normal.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ViewAsTip: Superposición de mapa mundial solo de sesión. Oculta sitios y columnas que esa facción no ha descubierto. Atenúa sitios conocidos fuera de la línea de visión actual. No cambia la niebla de combate ni la matemática de incursiones. Elige Jugador para restaurar el mapa completo.
